dateRangeParam.name: date
dateRangeParam.help: Select the earliest and latest dates to include comments posted in that range.

stringParam.name: project_id
stringParam.help: Project the comment was made on. Asterisks can be used as wildcards (e.g. "Plasmo*").

stringParam.name: user_name
stringParam.help: Search by the commenting user's name. Asterisks can be used as wildcards (e.g. "*smith*").

stringParam.name: organization
stringParam.help: Search by the commenting user's organization. Asterisks can be used as wildcards (e.g. "*university*").

stringParam.name: email
stringParam.help: Search by the commenting user's email. Asterisks can be used as wildcards (e.g. "*@example.com").

flatVocabParam.name: type
flatVocabParam.help: Select the type of record the comment was made on.

enumParam.name: is_ai_generated
enumParam.help: Restrict to comments that were (or were not) AI-generated.

sqlQuery.name: CommentTarget
sqlQuery.sql: SELECT comment_target_id AS internal, comment_target_id AS term, comment_target_name AS display FROM @REMOTE_COMMENT_SCHEMA@comment_target WHERE comment_target_id = 'gene' or comment_target_id = 'genomic' ORDER BY display
